remarks: Lovely 1-Bedroom, 1.5-Bath Townhouse-Style Condo in the Sought-After Chesterfield Complex - a gated community with 24-hour security and a serene, park-like setting in the heart of Mid-City Stamford.  This sunny corner unit features a bright eat in kitchen with tall ceilings, skylight, window, granite countertops. The spacious living and dining areas offer an ideal layout for everyday living and entertaining, complete with a cozy fireplace and sliders leading to a large private deck. A convenient half bath rounds out the main level.  Upstairs, the generously sized primary suite includes excellent closet space, a full bath with tub and shower, additional storage, and an in-unit washer and dryer.  Enjoy the many amenities this well-maintained community offers, including two pools, a clubhouse, and beautifully landscaped grounds - all just steps to shopping, and minutes to Downtown Stamford, Metro-North, and major highways.
